basics.name: Alex Example
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Backend-leaning full-stack engineer who builds reliable product systems and AI-assisted developer tooling.
basics.summaryVerbose: Backend-leaning full-stack engineer with a decade of shipping product systems: payments, internal tools and data pipelines. Lately focused on AI-assisted developer workflows, where an orchestrator hands real tickets to specialised agents with human approval gates, measured cost and test-first guardrails.

work.name: Example Payments Co.
work.summary: Own the payout reconciliation service and the internal tools used by the operations team.
highlights: Cut payout reconciliation time from hours to minutes by moving matching into an idempotent job pipeline
Led the migration of money values from floats to integer cents across 40 endpoints
Introduced characterization tests before refactors; zero money regressions in two years
highlightsVerbose: Designed the dead-letter and replay flow so failed matches are retried safely and visible to operations
Mentored three engineers through their first on-call rotations
Built an agent workflow that drafts test plans for tickets, reviewed by a human before any code is written

work.name: Sample Learning Platform
work.summary: Built course commerce and team-permission features for a learning platform.
highlights: Shipped team pages with role-based permissions used by 2,000+ organisations
Rebuilt the checkout tax calculation with exhaustive tests across 12 regions
highlightsVerbose: Moved support-escalated bugs into a weekly triage that halved repeat tickets

work.name: Demo Support Team
work.summary: Resolved technical escalations and built the scripts that became the team's first internal tools.
highlights: Automated the five most common account fixes, saving roughly ten hours a week

projects.name: Property ROI Calculator
projects.description: Real-estate ROI calculator with mortgage, HELOC and cash financing.
projects.descriptionVerbose: Next.js app that models cash flow, cash-on-cash return and appreciation for rental properties, with characterization tests pinning the financial maths before each refactor.
highlights: Pinned the ROI maths with independently recomputed characterization tests

projects.name: Agent workflow
projects.description: Orchestrator plus specialised subagents that take real tickets from plan to reviewed pull request.
highlights: Three merged pull requests at under one dollar each, with human approval gates
